reviews.text: It’s okay for me. It dried under my eyes and I end up having to wipe it away. I’ll try it again but not sure this one is going to win me over.
reviews.zh: 對我嚟講一般。會乾咗喺眼下面，搞到我最後要抹走。可能會再試多次，但唔肯定呢支會令我改觀。

reviews.shade: Dr.Melaxin Eyephalt Eye Cream for Eyebags 10ml
reviews.text: It's a good product. I feel tight around my eyes. I just used it for a few days and I hope it will have an effect on eye bags.
reviews.zh: 係好產品。眼周覺得緊緊哋。用咗幾日，希望對眼袋會有效果。

reviews.shade: Dr.Melaxin Eyephalt Eye Cream for Eyebags 10ml
reviews.text: Не очень поняла продукт. Буду дальше тестировать, похож на матирующий крем, подсушивает кожу
reviews.zh: 我唔係好明呢個產品。會繼續測試，睇落似霧面霜，會令皮膚變乾。

reviews.shade: Dr.Melaxin Eyephalt Eye Cream for Eyebags 10ml
reviews.text: I hated the texture so much that I didn't use it again. It feels like a naturalizing cream, not a moisturizing one. I didn't like it.
reviews.zh: 我好憎嗰個質地，所以冇再用過。感覺似霧面霜而唔係保濕霜。我唔鍾意。

reviews.shade: Dr.Melaxin Eyephalt Eye Cream for Eyebags 10ml
reviews.text:
Hmm. I havent used this more than a week and I ended up opening another eye cream. This is an interesting product... You squeeze two rice size amounts and apply to the lower eye. You want to apply swiping up. After awhile, it hardens a bit and you aren't suppose to do any facial motions that make that area cause creasing.

Im not sure if I really noticed a difference but I stopped because its not very hydrating. I like to layer my undereyes but when I did that, it caused piling. it would be hard for me to use this without any skincare underneath as its not hydrating and my undereyes are very dry.

Otherwise. I did notice a tingling when I first applied but didn't feel it the next 2 times. also interesting because there was no piling the first time but also I totally rubbed it in verses swiping up
reviews.zh:
嗯。我用咗唔夠一個禮拜就開咗另一支眼霜。呢個產品幾有趣⋯擠兩粒米咁大份量塗喺眼下，要由下向上掃。過一陣會變硬少少，唔好做任何令嗰個位皺起嘅面部動作。

我唔係好肯定有冇見到效果，但我停咗用因為唔算好保濕。我鍾意一層層疊塗眼底，但咁樣用會搓到起毛粒。如果底下唔塗護膚品就好難用，因為唔保濕，而我眼底好乾。

另一方面，第一次用嘅時候有少少刺刺哋，但之後兩次就冇感覺到。仲有樣幾有趣嘅事，第一次冇起毛粒，但係我嗰次完全係大力捽入去而唔係向上掃。

reviews.shade: Dr.Melaxin Eyephalt Eye Cream for Eyebags 10ml
reviews.text: This product makes your skin feel very tight, however I did not see any improvement of the dark circles nor the bags under the eyes
reviews.zh: 呢個產品令皮膚感覺好緊，但係黑眼圈同眼袋都冇見到有改善。

reviews.shade: Dr.Melaxin Eyephalt Eye Cream for Eyebags 10ml
reviews.text: Honestly, this rating feels a little generous. I used this for 3 weeks, nightly, and I don’t notice a difference in my eyebags. I started stressing over whether this product was good for my undereyes because it does tighten them, but it also makes them feel kinda dry. It’s hard to gauge how much to apply. It’d be helpful if the spatula it came with had some type of indicator for how much to use. Instructions also say to swipe 2-3 times, but I never felt like it covered enough surface area after those swipes. I was hoping to reduce my eyebags without having to do a lower blepharoplasty, but there are no shortcuts.
reviews.zh: 講真，呢個評分感覺有少少手鬆。我每晚用咗3個禮拜，眼袋都睇唔到有分別。我開始擔心呢個產品啱唔啱我眼底用，因為佢的確會收緊皮膚，但又會覺得有啲乾。要搵到啱嘅用量好難。如果支裝附上嘅刮棒有標示返用幾多就好啲。說明書寫要掃2-3次，但我從來都覺得掃完嗰幾下覆蓋嘅範圍唔夠大。我本來希望唔使做下眼瞼整容手術都可以減淡眼袋，但係冇捷徑。

reviews.shade: Dr.Melaxin Eyephalt Eye Cream for Eyebags 10ml
reviews.text:
직장동료 선물했는데 너무 효과가 좋다고 하내요
용량이이 작은게 아쉽지만 옆에서 눈으로 보기에 효과가 좋은 것 같아요

재구매 해달라고 해서 2개 추가 주문했어요
reviews.zh:
買咗送畀公司同事，佢話效果超好。
容量細咗少少有啲可惜，但係隔離睇落效果都好似幾好。

佢叫我再代購，所以我額外訂咗2支。
